$room..validate: !newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['maxPlayers','hostUid','started','turn','winner','players','createdAt','updatedAt']) && newData.child('maxPlayers').isNumber() && newData.child('maxPlayers').val() >= 2 && newData.child('maxPlayers').val() <= 4 && newData.child('hostUid').isString() && (!data.exists() || newData.child('hostUid').val() === data.child('hostUid').val()) && newData.child('started').isBoolean() && newData.child('turn').isNumber() && newData.child('turn').val() >= 0 && newData.child('turn').val() < newData.child('maxPlayers').val() && newData.child('winner').isNumber() && newData.child('winner').val() >= -1 && newData.child('winner').val() < newData.child('maxPlayers').val() && newData.child('players').numChildren() <= newData.child('maxPlayers').val() && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('updatedAt').isNumber())

$uid..validate: !newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['name','seat','connected','walls','pawn']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length > 0 && newData.child('name').val().length <= 18 && newData.child('seat').isNumber() && newData.child('seat').val() >= 0 && newData.child('seat').val() < 4 && newData.child('connected').isBoolean() && newData.child('walls').isNumber() && newData.child('walls').val() >= 0 && newData.child('walls').val() <= 10)

pawn..validate: newData.hasChildren(['x','y']) && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= 0 && newData.child('x').val() <= 8 && newData.child('y').isNumber() && newData.child('y').val() >= 0 && newData.child('y').val() <= 8

$wall..validate: newData.hasChildren(['x','y','orientation','owner']) && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= 0 && newData.child('x').val() <= 7 && newData.child('y').isNumber() && newData.child('y').val() >= 0 && newData.child('y').val() <= 7 && newData.child('orientation').isString() && (newData.child('orientation').val() === 'h' || newData.child('orientation').val() === 'v') && newData.child('owner').isNumber() && newData.child('owner').val() >= 0 && newData.child('owner').val() < 4
